statement: When the Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perp mid moves >= theta bp within 2 s and a crypto-beta equity perp (MSTR, COIN, HOOD, CRCL) on Lighter or trade[XYZ] has not yet followed (its mid has moved < theta*beta/2 in the same direction, beta = 1.0), a follower taker order in BTC's direction, arriving after our latency (plus Lighter's 300 ms Standard-account taker speed bump) and held H seconds, is profitable after fees and the recorded spread.
source: sources/leads/documented_edges_round8.md idea 2 (H-BETALAG). Deviations from the leads-file rule, set by the recording brief and stated here before data: (1) BTC trigger window 2 s instead of 10 s (same trigger shape as H-LIGHTLAG/H-EQLAG); (2) beta fixed at 1.0 instead of a trailing 7-day session regression, because the forward recording has no 7-day history at T0 and a fixed beta adds no fitted parameter (no look-ahead possible); (3) entry fills at the displayed opposite best capped at displayed top size (H-LIGHTLAG fill model) instead of walking the book, because only top-of-book is recorded; (4) cooldown 10 s after exit fill (as H-LIGHTLAG) instead of H.

beta.use: follower filter only: require d * r_F < theta * beta / 2 = theta / 2
beta.not_used: no trailing estimate; the beta of each name is not fitted on day 1 or later. A beta-scaled variant would be a new hypothesis id.

leader.stream: wss://fstream.binance.com bookTicker (the /market route is the fallback if the legacy route delivers nothing)

excluded.xyz:MSTR: not growth-mode eligible (trade.xyz doc: crypto-wrapper perps such as MSTR) -> 9.0 bp taker per side at tier 0; EXCLUDED from scoring. Its bbo is recorded as a diagnostic only.
excluded.MARA, RIOT: not listed on Lighter or xyz at 2026-10-05 07:42Z
excluded.BMNR: listed (Lighter 123, xyz:BMNR) but an ETH-treasury name, not a BTC-beta name; not recorded

data.recorder: scripts/research/betalag_recorder.py -> data/raw/web/betalag/<venue>_bbo_<YYYY-MM-DD-HH>.parquet (binance_bbo: BTC; lighter_bbo: MSTR COIN HOOD CRCL; xyz_bbo: COIN HOOD CRCL MSTR) + meta_xyz.jsonl, meta_lighter.jsonl (hourly) + events.jsonl (connect/disconnect times)
data.clock_rule: All decisions and fills use our local receive timestamps ts_us (microseconds) only; venue timestamps (exch_ts_ms) are diagnostics (the container clock runs ~2.8 s behind venue clocks). A venue state 'at time t' is the last recorded row with ts_us <= t.

split.T0: start_ts_us of the 48-h betalag recorder run ('start' line in data/raw/web/betalag/recorder.log). Rows before T0 (test runs, kept in a scratch directory) are never scored.
split.day1_train: [T0, T0+24h): exploratory; trigger counts first, then the kill test, then all 12 configs; ONE config selected by the selection rule
split.day2_validation: [T0+24h, T0+48h): the selected config only, run ONCE
split.forward: after day 2: freeze (sha256 of the scoring module, params, frozen_at) and score only data received after the freeze time

data.gaps: A venue is in a gap from a disconnect event to the first bbo row after the next connect event (events.jsonl), or while the Binance BTC feed has no row for > 10 s. Follower books that are merely quiet (no change) are NOT gaps (the recorder drops unchanged repeats). No trigger may be taken while the leader or that follower venue is in a gap; a position whose entry or exit time falls in a gap is filled at the first state after the gap and flagged.

sessions: us_cash = Mon-Fri 13:30-20:00 UTC (NYSE regular hours under EDT, valid for the planned run 2026-10-05..07; if the forward record runs past 2026-11-01 it becomes 14:30-21:00 UTC; NYSE holidays count as off-hours); off_hours = all other times. Session is assigned by the trigger time t. Every result is reported for us_cash and off_hours separately as well as pooled. Session is NOT a grid dimension and NOT used for selection.

rule.binance_mid: (bid+ask)/2 of BTCUSDT from the binance bbo stream
rule.trigger: At each binance BTC bbo row (decision time t = its ts_us): r_B = mid_B(t)/mid_B(t-2s) - 1, with mid_B(t-2s) the last state at or before t-2 s. Trigger if |r_B| >= theta. Direction d = sign(r_B).
rule.follower_filter: For each follower f (name x venue) separately: r_F = mid_F(t)/mid_F(t-2s) - 1 with the follower's own last recorded states; require d * r_F < theta * beta / 2 (beta = 1.0). The follower must have a recorded bbo at or before t-2s on the current connection.
rule.entry: Taker in direction d on the follower venue. Fill time t_in = t + L (Lighter L = 600 ms = ~300 ms our path, assumed + 300 ms Standard taker speed bump, DOC; xyz L = 300 ms, assumed). Buy fills at the last recorded follower best ask at t_in, sell at best bid.
rule.exit: Exit decision at t_in + H; exit fill time t_out = t_in + H + L at the last recorded follower opposite best at t_out.
rule.position_rules: one position per name per venue; cooldown 10 s after the exit fill before that name x venue can trigger again; no stop; no early exit.
rule.size: target $1,000 notional. Entry size = min($1,000, displayed opposite top-of-book notional at t_in). If that displayed top notional is < $100 the trigger is SKIPPED and counted as a skip. Exit: size up to the displayed opposite top at t_out fills at that price; any excess fills one full spread (ask-bid at t_out) worse.

fees_per_side.lighter: 0 bp (Standard account, DOC docs.lighter.xyz trading-fees and apidocs account-types; hourly orderBooks snapshot taker_fee is used if it changes)
fees_per_side.xyz: 0.9 bp taker (growth mode, tier 0 base rate, DOC docs.trade.xyz fees) x deployerFeeScale, for names whose latest hourly meta snapshot at or before entry shows growthMode 'enabled'; 9.0 bp x deployerFeeScale otherwise (a name losing growth mode during the run pays 9 bp, it is not dropped).
fees_per_side.note: The spread is paid through the fill model; no zero-impact fills.

rule.funding: ignored (holds <= 601 s); positions whose hold spans a venue funding timestamp are counted and reported.
rule.pnl_unit: USD per round trip; bp = USD / entry notional * 1e4

grid.pooling: within a config, round trips are pooled over that venue's names

kill_test_day1: Before the grid: for all theta = 10 bp triggers on day 1 that pass the follower filter (no position rules, no size cap), the mean of d * (mid_F(t+120 s)/mid_F(t+L) - 1) in bp, pooled over each venue's names. If it is < 2.5 bp (about one recorded spread) on BOTH venues, H-BETALAG is KILLED regardless of the grid. A venue whose mean is < 2.5 bp is dropped from selection. Reported with n triggers, n distinct BTC triggers, and by session.
selection_rule_day1: Among configs with n >= 30 round trips on day 1, select the one with the highest profit factor (ties: larger n). If no config has net USD > 0 and PF > 1.0 on day 1, H-BETALAG is KILLED and day 2 is not run. The selected config must also show net USD > 0 with +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip; if it does not, the next-best config by the same rule that does is taken.
validation_day2: Run the selected config once on day 2. Bar: n >= 50 round trips, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without the top-3 trades > 0. If n < 50 the result is INCONCLUSIVE (not a pass); the config is frozen anyway and the forward record continues until n >= 50; no re-selection. A failure is written to reports/failures/.
dependence_note: One BTC trigger can open up to 4 (Lighter) or 3 (xyz) correlated positions. Report n round trips AND n distinct BTC triggers; the bar uses round trips (as H-LIGHTLAG/H-EQLAG), but a pass with < 20 distinct BTC triggers is reported as fragile.
reporting: Report trigger counts first (BTC triggers per theta, per session; follower-filter pass rates per name x venue), then the kill test, then all 12 day-1 configs by name and session (n, net, mean bp, PF, skips, gap flags), then the day-2 result, losses included. xyz:MSTR is reported only as an unscored diagnostic with its 9 bp fee.
no_changes: No change to the universe, beta, trigger, grid, fill model, fees rule, split, kill test or selection rule after this file is written. A change requires a new hypothesis id with a rationale (parent + failing run).
